_notice: FICTITIOUS. Coverage records and pharmacy, benefit and prior authorization transactions for synthetic patients who do not exist, on plans that do not exist. Member ids and group numbers are invented.
usage: The payer-side history behind each case in test-design/ps-cases.json. Every plan shipment that has left the pharmacy has one paid claim on the same date for its package's NDC and quantity; bridge and Foundation shipments are never billed to a plan. copay_claim is the copay program paying after the plan, never more than the patient's cost share and never more than $16,000 in a calendar year; its total for the as_of year equals the case's copay.used_ytd. benefit_check dates equal bv.completed_on; pa_request, pa_decision and appeal dates equal the case's pa dates. patient_pay is null on a rejected claim.
